title: Bits of an encoding row
statement: Given a configuration encoding row, assign a Boolean value to each tagged bit position as follows. At an input coordinate use the corresponding input bit; at an input-head or state coordinate use $1$ exactly when that coordinate is the row's selected position or state. For a work-tape coordinate, the first and second slots indicate, respectively, that the cell contains false or true, and the third indicates that the work-tape head is at that cell. At an output-summary coordinate, the bit is $1$ exactly when the row's summary is dead for the first coordinate or accepting for the second.
hypotheses_covered: The row has machine $M$ and parameters $n,s$ as in the encoding-row definition
caveat: The statement uses the three work-tape slots and two summary coordinates in the order specified by the definition.
